$comment: #EXP-1629: THE Avatar fallback rule every Exponential UI renderer replays (React, Solid, Swift, Compose, gpui), the app's own (packages/design-tokens `avatar`, EXP-698 r4) so an eUI avatar and the app's UserAvatar of one person look the same. `palette` = design-tokens `avatar` in ITS order (append-only, never reorder: the index is what the hash lands on). A `seed` (a user id) picks `palette[fnv1a32(utf8(seed)) % 8]` (`hues` pins the hash: the app's 8-id fixture); the fallback fills with that hue at `fillAlpha` and draws the initials in it at full alpha, no stroke. No seed (absent or empty) = the `Avatar/fallback` recipe colours (muted). `initials` pins the letters of `name`: an email reduces to its local part, the rest splits on space . _ - +; two or more parts give their first letters, one part its first two characters; uppercased; nothing = `?`. The recipe sizes the letters at half the diameter, regular weight; a picture wears the `Avatar/image` ring (a hairline in `$color.border`), the IDE's gpui-component Avatar.
